scope: GNU/Linux dynamic ELF loading; PLT/GOT paths depend on architecture and build configuration.

claims.claim: Dynamic loader handles dependencies and dynamic symbol binding.
Some function calls can be lazily resolved; -z now requests earlier binding.
claims.notes: Do not assume every binary uses traditional PLT.

claims.claim: LD_PRELOAD affects symbol lookup; secure execution mode imposes restrictions.
claims.notes: Interposition is not a security boundary.

claims.claim: RTLD_NEXT allows resolving the next matching definition after current object.
claims.notes: Example uses puts instead of recursive malloc wrappers.

claims.claim: PIC with x86-64 RIP-relative addressing avoids absolute code relocations where possible.
claims.notes: Instructions are illustrative; actual disassembly depends on flags.

claims.claim: Preloaded puts wrapper adds a prefix then calls the next puts.
